message.content:
Below is a concise list of the federal statutory holidays that create “long weekends” (i.e., holidays that fall on a weekday, giving you an extra day off) in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(If you’re targeting a specific province or territory, you’ll want to add the local holidays that apply there – see the notes at the bottom.)

| Date | Day of Week | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-------------|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Creates a long weekend if you take Monday, Jan 2 off. |
| **January 16** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Long weekend in those provinces. |
| **February 20** | Monday | Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Long weekend in Manitoba. |
| **March 20** | Monday | Good Friday | Creates a long weekend (Good Friday + Easter Monday). |
| **April 7** | Monday | Victoria Day | Long weekend in all provinces except Quebec. |
| **May 22** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (BC, Yukon) | Long weekend in BC & Yukon. |
| **June 19** | Monday | St. Jean Baptiste Day (Quebec) | Long weekend in Quebec. |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | Creates a long weekend if you take Monday, July 3 off. |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Long weekend in most provinces (except Quebec). |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | Long weekend in all provinces. |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving Day | Long weekend in all provinces. |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day | Long weekend in all provinces. |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Long weekend in all provinces. |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | Creates a long weekend if you take Monday, Dec 24 off. |

### How to use this data

* **API Integration** – If your holiday‑planning app pulls holiday data from an API, you can store these dates in a database table keyed by `date`, `holiday_name`, and `province` (where applicable).  
* **User Preferences** – Allow users to select which provinces they’re interested in; filter the list accordingly.  
* **Custom Alerts** – Offer push notifications or email reminders a week before each long weekend so users can plan trips in advance.

### Provincial/Territorial Variations

| Province/Territory | Additional Long‑Weekend Holidays (2023) |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------|
| British Columbia | May 22 (National Indigenous Peoples Day) |
| Manitoba | February 20 (Louis Riel Day) |
| Ontario | January 16 (Family Day) |
| Quebec | June 19 (St. Jean Baptiste Day) |
| Saskatchewan | January 16 (Family Day) |
| Alberta | January 16 (Family Day) |
| Others | Civic Holiday (August 7) applies in most provinces but not in Quebec. |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data formatted as JSON, CSV, or integrated into a specific programming language!
